visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and bangs, wearing a brown scoop-neck sports top and black leggings, stands in a brightly lit outdoor pavilion. She speaks directly to the camera, gesturing frequently with her hands and occasionally touching her hair. The background features beige curtains draped over a wooden frame, stone pillars, and green foliage visible in the distance. The lighting is bright and natural, suggesting daytime. (2) The scene transitions to a series of yoga movements on a red mat over a tiled floor. The woman, now seen in a full-body shot, performs a standing forward fold, followed by downward-facing dog and child's pose. (3) The camera returns to the medium close-up of the woman talking. She continues her energetic delivery, shifting her gaze and using expressive facial movements. (4) An informational graphic appears on the screen, showing a man and a woman in traditional clothing with text about a yoga course. (5) Another graphic labeled 'Point 1' shows diagrams of yoga poses and text in Chinese, followed by a 'Point 3' graphic listing breathing techniques. (6) The woman concludes her speech, using both hands to gesture near her face in a playful, framing motion as she smiles warmly.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我來尼泊爾之後. (2) [Variety]: （口誤）. (3) [Subtitle]: 我發現尼泊爾人幾乎完全沒有失眠的問題. (4) [Subtitle]: 因為他們超級懂得怎麼放鬆自己的神經系統. (5) [Subtitle]: 所以我就請我的尼泊爾瑜伽老師教了我一套15分鐘的睡前好眠瑜伽. (6) [Subtitle]: 它每個動作都是在啟動副交感神經. (7) [Subtitle]: 像是嬰兒式啊然後下犬式. (8) [Subtitle]: 前彎前屈式還有一些呼吸法等等的. (9) [Subtitle]: 你們知道有效到什麼地步嗎. (10) [Subtitle]: 就15分鐘的瑜伽我通常做到5分鐘我就完全撐不住了. (11) [Subtitle]: 甚至有一次就是我在瑜伽老師他們的Hotel做完那個瑜伽. (12) [Subtitle]: 我只是坐5分鐘的計程車在路上我都睡著了. (13) [Subtitle]: 所以瑜伽老師說這一套你一定要在床的旁邊做. (14) [Subtitle]: 因為你很可能會回不了自己的床上. (15) [Subtitle]: 所以其實我已經把我的尼泊爾老師開了一堂來自瑜伽發源地的正宗瑜伽課程. (16) [Logo]: 尼泊爾 正宗瑜伽. (17) [Slogan]: 開啟七大脈輪 喚醒全身能量 附中英雙語配音. (18) [Subtitle]: 那課程總共至少8個小時. (19) [Slogan]: Point 1 35種體式正位教學. (20) [Subtitle]: 裡面包括35個常見瑜伽體式的正位與解剖學. (21) [Subtitle]: 就是他會把你教到非常詳細你絕對會了解之後每一個式該怎麼做. (22) [Slogan]: Point 3 古老呼吸法篇. (23) [Subtitle]: 還有8種呼吸法的訓練. (24) [Subtitle]: 然後我們還收錄了4個小時8種不同功能型的跟練. (25) [Subtitle]: 譬如說像是這個睡眠瑜伽或是1小時的早晨活力瑜伽. (26) [Subtitle]: 然後下班後的負能量跟緊繃排除瑜伽. (27) [Subtitle]: 所以呢如果大家想要用非常簡單易懂的方式去了解尼泊爾的古老智慧. (28) [Subtitle]: 就絕對必須買這一堂尼泊爾的正宗瑜伽課.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement for a comprehensive yoga course developed in Nepal. It uses the creator's personal struggle with sleep and her positive experience with yoga as a hook to present the course's detailed curriculum as a solution.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The speaker directly presents an 8-hour yoga course featuring specific teachers (Raj and Deepa) and encourages the audience to purchase it.
